GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide until 3 Wide @ 500m & improving Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & chased honestly in last 150m. # OK from rear.
Jumped Ok drifted back rail 7l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, worked home well closer to rail making steady ground # hit line well

Slow Out . Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed same until improving on inside from 600m & Two Wide @ 450m. Held up Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & held ground 3 Wide in last 200m. # didn't finish off
Jumped Ok Restrained to slot in Settled Down Just Off Mid-Field 3 Wide with cover 5 Lengths asked to go at the Turn clear run home Outside Kept Finding 1st sat 2nd Closest on line, # Sound eff/finale

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3-then-4 Wide Straightening Up , worked through gap at the 250m and kept coming to the line. [Stewards: Inquiry into jockey's riding opened and adjourned.] # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. An inquiry into A. Mallyon’s riding of the gelding between the 600m and 200m was opened and adjourned to a date to be fixed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up looking for gaps, found some in the run but needed more luck to figure properly in the finish. Not tested final 100m. # needed more luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m was directed out around heels to continue to improve. Unable to be fully tested over the final 100m when racing in restricted room between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up home turn then worked through field from the 250m # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Settled worse than midfield from a wide barrier. Rounding the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until near the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length then kicked up quickly and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, raield up to 2 Lengths turning, Held Up rounding turn and blocked on initially straightening, worked into gap and around heels at 275m, hit Lead 180m, got clear and kept gouing to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Shortly after straightening was eased out and bumped another runner wider to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Tongue Tie first time ) slow out x 1.5 Lengths . Settled Down a Clear last. 5.5 Lengths @ 700m. fanned widest Straightening Up looming Mid Field . closed soundly, Just missed 3rd place. $11 Winner Led All The Way # from last/1st led
